purpose: Make cross-provider Orion architecture, glossary, source provenance, Git history recovery and reproducible examples understandable to other AIs and humans.
expected_behavior: A third-party model can locate authoritative definitions, identify provenance and evidence tiers, run a tiny synthetic test, and distinguish historical code from example code.
observations: The generated toy preserves one failing and one passing candidate.
Git history recovery remains incomplete; 26 local commits are beyond the old remote main.
failures: Earlier GitHub plugin contents writes returned HTTP 403; owner-authorized Git CLI used.
Historical Google recovered source inventory is incomplete and must not be silently promoted to current production.
notes: AI proposed content; desktop Git CLI used owner's authenticated GitHub account for publication. Timestamp is workflow anchor, not a verified second-level capture of every file write.
